verdict.rationale: Forter documents an official MCP server enabling natural-language control of reviewing decisions, managing disputes, and updating policies (forter-docs-9), with concrete setup for conversational workflows via Claude Desktop (forter-docs-20), corroborated by an independent probe confirming the MCP docs endpoint (forter-probe-2).
